title: Studio
description: A physical or virtual recording location. Studios are first-class objects in HOSPES — they drive routing logic (which city, which space, whose equipment), touring-guest interception (batch guests in the same city), and visual grammar specifications. Studios may be host-owned, venue-rented, or remote.

studio_id.description: Stable UUID or slug for this studio.

name.description: Common name for this studio (e.g. 'Melrose Studios', 'NYC Satellite', 'Austin Home Setup').

city.description: City where this studio is located. Used for routing and touring-guest batching.

state_or_region.description: State or region (for disambiguation in large metro areas).

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling logic.

ownership.description: Whether the show owns, rents, or uses this space. 'field' = Anthony's portable field-show setup.

address_public.description: Public-facing address or neighborhood. Do not store precise private addresses inline. Private addresses live in operator-local files.

technical_profile.description: Technical capabilities: microphone rigs, camera setup, acoustic profile, lighting, streaming capability.

hidden_mic_capable.description: Whether the studio supports concealed microphone placement (per 'no visible microphones' visual grammar rule).

visual_grammar_profile_id.description: Reference to the visual language specification used in this studio. Portable Salon Kernel v0–v2 are examples.

routing_priority.description: Priority rank when multiple studios are available for a given city and guest. Lower = preferred.

availability_notes.description: Any standing constraints on availability (e.g. 'Tuesday–Thursday only', 'requires 2-week lead').

on_site_contact.description: Name of the on-site contact for guests (not a private phone number — that lives in operator-local files).

active.description: Whether this studio is currently available for booking.
